goal: Implement the project plan phase by phase and keep pushing unresolved work into the next task.

phases.title: Discovery
phases.objective: Understand the codebase and identify the change surface before editing.

tasks.title: Architecture review
tasks.prompt: Inspect the repository, identify the modules that must change for the user plan, and make direct edits only if the work is obvious and low risk.

tasks.title: Risk and test review
tasks.prompt: Review the current workspace state, identify missing tests, regression risks, and any implementation gaps left by previous tasks.

phases.title: Implementation
phases.objective: Apply the actual feature work and fold prior gaps into the implementation step.

tasks.title: Primary implementation
tasks.prompt: Implement the requested work, use prior carryover items as mandatory followups, and list any remaining unfinished work precisely.

tasks.title: Verification pass
tasks.prompt: Review the implementation, tighten any weak areas, and produce the exact remaining followups for the next iteration.
